name: “I want to travel the world but it’s too expensive…”

lines.ref:
“I want to travel the world
but it’s too expensive…”

welcome to my page,
I got you❤️

shots.brief: travel transit shot, leaning out or looking out window (ref: Creator hanging out of an open train door taking a wide selfie as scenic landscape rushes past; selfie)
action or cliff jump into water (ref: Person doing a backflip off a rock into a tropical waterfall pool; filmed by friend)
energetic running on beach or outdoors (ref: Creator running happily across a sunny beach holding a surfboard; filmed by friend)
running towards camera outdoors (ref: Creator running with open arms down a muddy jungle trail; filmed by friend)
jumping into water (ref: Two people jumping off a boat or high ledge into deep blue ocean; filmed by friend)
excited reaction shot from car or transit (ref: Creator shouting excitedly out of a car window on a dirt road; selfie)
scenic landscape overlook with arms spread (ref: Creator turning with open arms on a scenic mountain overlook; filmed by friend)
adventurous travel transit (ref: Two friends sitting on the roof rack of a safari vehicle driving through the jungle; filmed from vehicle behind)
happy smiling selfie in nature (ref: Creator smiling and laughing in a shallow tropical stream; selfie)
POV riding bike, scooter, or driving (ref: First-person perspective driving a scooter around a mountain road curve; POV)
following shot riding down scenic road (ref: Following shot of creator riding a scooter along an open rural road towards hills; filmed from vehicle behind)
group laughing selfie shot (ref: Group of friends in an open-air vehicle shouting and laughing together; selfie)

audit.notes: Highly reusable format. The hook features a relatable objection or barrier (e.g. 'I want to live in NYC / get fit / boulder V7 but...'), followed by quick 0.3-0.5s beat-synced b-roll cuts showcasing the creator's lifestyle, with a caption containing actionable, numbered value tips.
audit.summary: Fast-paced travel b-roll montage pairing a relatable objection hook ('I want to travel the world but it’s too expensive...') with high-energy travel clips that promise solutions in the caption.
